in_hebrew.name: Anniken
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Anniken הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old Norse name Anne, meaning grace or mercy. The suffix -ken may indicate a diminutive or a beloved one.

in_greek.name: Anniken
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Graceful, loving
in_greek.long_meaning: Anniken είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Old Norse name Anne, meaning grace or mercy. The suffix -ken may indicate a diminutive or a beloved one.

in_latin.name: Anniken
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Graceful, loving
in_latin.long_meaning: Anniken est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Old Norse name Anne, meaning grace or mercy. The suffix -ken may indicate a diminutive or a beloved one.
